recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR-49750. Handle any experimental=true update under FHIR-55253/FHIR-55255 or another explicit issue-reconcile task rather than conflating it with this already-applied property-type replacement.
issue_request: FHIR-49750 was an Applied/Persuasive OO change request for R6 reporting that Device.property.type used an example ValueSet of device types rather than property types; the accepted resolution was to remove the old binding content and create a new example CodeSystem and ValueSet for device property types.
initial_application: The issue was already applied by Jira-tagged commits: 0c804fd03064bf99a83505160fd04ae559a14f12 added source/device/codesystem-device-property-type.xml, renamed the ValueSet computable name to DevicePropertyType, removed ISO 11073/GMDN/SNOMED device-type includes, and composed only http://hl7.org/fhir/device-property-type; 8a1913129feaee34ab3d20614b4eca0d7f21d233 added example-purpose descriptions; 3bf923f62edfec86ce552a981852a744e47f4e39 updated both titles to "Device Property Type (Example only)".
additional_context: Device is active in source/fhir.ini, and the current Device.property.type and DeviceDefinition.property.type bindings both point to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/device-property-type with bindingName DevicePropertyType. Later Resolved - change required issues FHIR-55253 and FHIR-55255 separately propose marking this example CodeSystem/ValueSet experimental=true, but they are not Applied/Published and are outside this seed decision.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current CodeSystem and ValueSet describe fixed characteristics or conditions of the device, include property examples such as material, size, storage, and color, and no longer contain the prior device-type/SNOMED-style content.
